output.summary: Evergreen flowering shrub native to western North America, from southeastern Alaska to northern California and central New Mexico. It has glossy, holly-like spiny leaflets and dense clusters of yellow spring flowers followed by tart, dusty-blue berries.
output.edibilityNote: Tart, large-seeded fruits are eaten raw after the first frosts; traditionally used sparingly with sweeter fruit, and now sometimes made into jelly or wine.
